comments.content:
We should standardize messaging through the kernel ideally, or at minimum via our SDK
We should adhere to the `ok`, `info`, `error`, `fatal` message classes with the coloring via the diff styling accordingly as I implemented in v1
Shouldn't the logger automatically post the comment? We should only use the logger then instead of octokit post comment.
Should only be using our logger. Never console. How will this be debugged remotely?
Not in spec but if you default to allow everybody to query then it's fine.

There's an environment variable in the version one of the bots that sets what log level should be commented. For example, `info` logs don't necessarily have to be commented, but `fatal` and `error` yes

We don't really use `multiplier` anymore that's true but one of the first questions that powerhouse asked related to the capabilities of `multiplier` so I feel like we should not neglect this capability as it may find more use in other organizations
